brief.ask: Art-direct "Frankincense & Gold Dust" — #10 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Contemplative Light). Premise: Swinging brass thurible censer, aromatic smoke plumes, and diagonal altar beam. An ornate brass thurible censer swings gently in the upper sanctuary while silky curls of liturgical incense rise through a diagonal shaft of warm amber altar light. Lighting today: Key: Single diagonal 3400K altar spot cutting through dark nave. Service use: Prayer, intercession, Sanctus, contemplative worship. Audio mapping today: Swell → Widens the ascending incense smoke curl & altar beam; Vocal → Brightens the swinging brass thurible censer & smoke scattering; Shimmer → Drifts fine suspended gold dust motes. Palette: #09080C #241B18 #D49448 #FFF2DC. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: The Tectonic Measure of Sacred Light
proposals.idea: The sanctuary is structured as a classical basilica section where light and smoke adhere to strict architectural counterpoint rather than theatrical haze.
proposals.geometry: A 5:8 harmonic section grid based on classical Latin cross proportions. The diagonal altar beam is locked precisely to a 33.7-degree angle extending from the upper transept intersection down to the altar focal point, dividing the lower third reading band along a strict golden section baseline.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif in tracked Small Caps (size 32px at 1080p, 0.18em tracking) for the lyric band, anchored strictly to the lower golden ratio grid line. Line height is fixed at 1.618; words reveal through an unyielding left-to-right cadence that respects the verse bar lines without dynamic shifting.
proposals.imageLogic: Three distinct depth planes governed by architectural hierarchy: Plane 1 (Nave Shadow #09080C) provides structural mass; Plane 2 (Altar Beam & Procedural Censer #241B18 / #D49448) acts as the cantus firmus plane; Plane 3 (Ascending Smoke Bezier Curves & Motes #FFF2DC) provides dynamic counterpoint, constrained strictly within the 3400K light cone.
proposals.texture: A fine copperplate architectural etching grain combined with cold-pressed vellum tooth across the dark nave pass, giving the procedural light volumetric weight akin to light passing through historic leaded glass.
proposals.motion: The thurible executes a precise compound pendulum motion governed by gravitational constant equations. Ascending incense curls move as two counter-directed, slow-moving fluid streamlines. Audio swell expands the beam width along the grid lines without distorting the underlying baseline.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D procedural rendering using cached offscreen vector buffers for the censer geometry and architectural hatch shading, combined with parametric Bezier smoke curves evaluated on an immutable harmonic timing grid at 60 fps.
proposals.humanTrace: Pendulum motion equations calibrated against real-world video analysis of a 12-kilogram cathedral censer swing, preserving natural friction decay and manual push cadence.
proposals.risk: Risks appearing visually rigid to those accustomed to liquid visualizer effects, but this tectonic discipline guarantees complete lyric legibility from forty meters in any nave.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist wants dynamic volumetric theatricality and dramatic light bursts; I demand that the altar beam remain an immutable architectural boundary that governs the scene rather than a stage effect.

proposals.title: Dhofar Route & Pierced Brass Geometry
proposals.idea: Ground the sanctuary beam in the specific geometry of 12th-century Levantine metalwork and the physical opacity of Dhofar frankincense resin smoke, refusing generic stage theater.
proposals.geometry: A strict 31.7°N altitude ray angle across four bay divisions derived from Syrian octagonal censer proportions (1:1.618 base-to-chain ratio), placing the lyric band on an unhurried 22% lower baseline.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif in title case with unhurried 0.14em tracking for lyrics (34px), anchored by JetBrains Mono 10px field-notebook coordinates (17°01'N 54°05'E / Dhofar) in #D49448 at 35% opacity along the outer margin.
proposals.imageLogic: Procedural Canvas 2D path construction of an eight-aperture pierced brass censer silhouette casting true geometric light-cone shadows, avoiding pre-rendered concept plates entirely.
proposals.texture: A raw linen weave substrate generated from a 19th-century Levantine textile thread-count matrix, carrying procedural 0.8px gold resin motes that scatter light using authentic oleoresin refractive indices.
proposals.motion: A physically damped Lissajous pendulum swing (3.4-second period) for the brass thurible, driving a delayed particle smoke plume along a wind-vector field that expands gracefully during vocal swells.
proposals.productionMethod: Trigonometric path rendering for the censer hardware coupled with dual-layer procedural noise-field smoke generation, run live at 60fps through Plajah's Canvas 2D audio engine.
proposals.humanTrace: The micro-friction of a 2px misregistration offset between the linen paper underlay and the gold ink vector, mimicking traditional hand-printed liturgical block motifs.
proposals.risk: Including geographic field-notebook coordinates risks looking overly academic to a modern congregation, but it restores sacred physical weight and rescues the visualizer from becoming a generic screensaver.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist reaches for theatrical golden dust before asking whose gold it is; I insist on anchoring the scene in Dhofar resin history and Levantine metalwork so sacred grandeur isn't stolen.

proposals.title: The Single Vector of Light
proposals.idea: Stripping the sanctuary to its singular structural line: a 12-degree beam of amber cutting absolute dark, where incense is a silent column of illuminated air anchoring one line of text.
proposals.geometry: A strict 12-degree diagonal axis running from top-right to bottom-left, dividing the canvas into 82% silent dark void (#09080C) and 18% illuminated atmosphere (#D49448). The lyric band anchors precisely to the horizontal golden section line where the diagonal vector crosses the lower third.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif in small caps, 22pt at 1080p, tracking at +0.22em. Color: #FFF2DC at 90% opacity. One line at a time, left-aligned to the diagonal beam's origin point, avoiding centered theatricality. No drop shadows; legibility is guaranteed by a procedural subtractive dark band beneath the vector.
proposals.imageLogic: No painted or rendered metal censer. The thurible is declared entirely through its physical effect: a single procedurally calculated catenary curve representing the tension of the chain, and a narrow Gaussian light strip representing the smoke column where it intersects the 3400K beam.
proposals.texture: A low-contrast, dry slate material weave. The optical pass strips away anamorphic flaring and light leaks, leaving a muted, unglazed matte depth mask that turns the deep background into absorbent physical shadow rather than digital black.
proposals.motion: The catenary chain sways on a strict 0.12 Hz pendulum harmonic. Swell slowly expands the beam's stroke width by 15%; Vocal brightness modulates only the density of the center line, not its spread; Shimmer releases exactly sixteen single-pixel dust points along the light axis.
proposals.productionMethod: Generative Canvas 2D math. The censer chain is drawn using hyperbolic cosine stroke paths; the altar ray is a single angled linear gradient clipped to a quad-path; text is rendered via Canvas native text rendering over a mathematically generated, anti-aliased dimming slot.
proposals.humanTrace: The physical gravity encoded into the pendulum algorithm—a continuous, damped friction decay curve modeled on an actual heavy brass object swinging in still sanctuary air.
proposals.risk: Risks being mistaken for extreme austerity by congregations expecting ornate brass renders and volumetric theatrical fog; worth it because removing the decorative noise leaves the lyric as the absolute focal center.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist demands surging volumetric smoke clouds and carved brass filigree to force theatrical grandeur; I reduce the scene to one line of tension and one ray of light, because reverence lives in silence, not saturation.
